title: Triage Before Geography
note: Renata's interior of the same first 3-5 minutes Cole and Mnehmos render from their interiors. She arrives with her arm still up from the surgical room, scans the cohort by hazard not identity, queries her own sheet, hears Cole's 'off the brass line' as meaning-without-speaker, and gives the wet-clothed surveyor one professional sentence directing her toward the lamp ring. No touch without consent.

origin.universe: Contemporary Earth — a trauma surgical room

litRPG_surface: Renata's OOC blocks render as :::triagebox (per-soul medical roster with stable/watch/urgent/black tags), :::statbox (sheet, consent ledger, glove status), :::action (verb+target+cost+return), :::systemvoice (⟦ ⟧ engine returns in CAPS).

events.note: She arrives with her arm still in the gloved-and-ready posture from the surgical room. She does not lower it until the triage cycle completes.

returns.wet-clothed surveyor: watch — wet-fabric exposure load; no visible hemorrhage
returns.heavy-equipment man: stable — floor-balance compensation; no visible acute injury
returns.mason on one knee: stable — no visible acute limb hazard; reading slab
returns.sightlines woman: stable — no visible acute injury; dust exposure only

events.note: Surface only. No names known. No interiors.

events.returned: LIMITS CONFIRMED: motive not readable; allegiance forecast refused; non-physical emergents not accessible; soul-interiors not visible; language bridge provisional
events.note: Honest engine return. Renata's response: 'Good. The engine wouldn't let me romanticize.'

events.returned: FIELD SURGEON SHEET — L1 human surgeon. NO SPELL SLOTS. Hands and training only. HP 9/9 AC 11. Consent floor active.
events.note: Plain sheet readout. No magic granted. The discipline she brought is the discipline she has.

events.renata_reaction: Recognized meaning. Not speaker. Directive landed like a scalpel.

events.spoken: You. Wet cloth — move toward the lamp ring. Keep your feet off the brass.
events.note: Professional, short. Did NOT touch. Honored the consent floor.
Triage cycle complete. Sheet verified. Voice applied. No one bled out in the first minute. 'That's not luck. That's procedure.'

ledger_state_at_chapter_end.engine_limits_acknowledged: no motive read; no allegiance forecast; non-physical emergents inaccessible
